envtest.description: Envtest configures the in-process apiserver backend (`--cluster envtest`).

kind.description: Kind configures the kind backend (`--cluster kind`).

k3d.description: K3d configures the k3d backend (`--cluster k3d`).

kubeconfig.description: Kubeconfig configures the external-cluster backend (`--cluster kubeconfig`).

ClusterConfig.description: ClusterConfig groups the per-backend settings for the cluster tiers of `vigie test`.

release.description: Release is the release identity passed to `helm template`.

Defaults.description: Defaults holds the values every test inherits unless a suite-level `defaults:` or a per-test `inputs:` block overrides them.

kubeVersion.description:
KubeVersion pins the envtest binary asset version. Empty uses the
built-in default. Overridden by `--kube-version`.

EnvtestConfig.description: EnvtestConfig configures the envtest backend, which runs a real kube-apiserver and etcd in-process with no controllers.

rule.description:
Rule is the namespaced rule ID to suppress, e.g.
`template-best-practices_missing-resource-limits`.

paths.description:
Paths are glob patterns matched against the finding's source file path.
Empty suppresses the rule everywhere.

IgnoreRule.description: IgnoreRule suppresses a specific rule, optionally scoped to file paths.

path.description:
Path is the kubeconfig file to reach the cluster with. Mirrors
`helm --kubeconfig`. No shell expansion happens, so `~` is not a home
directory here. Overridden by `--kubeconfig`.

KubeconfigBackendConfig.description: KubeconfigBackendConfig configures the kubeconfig backend, which runs against a cluster the user already operates.

ruleSets.description: RuleSets is an allowlist of rule sets to run. Empty means "all defaults".

disableRules.description:
DisableRules is a denylist of individual rule IDs that must not run, even
if their rule set is enabled. Distinct from Ignore, which filters
findings post-execution by path.

kubeVersions.description:
KubeVersions lists the Kubernetes versions to render against for
deprecation and version-aware rules. Each is a `MAJOR.MINOR` string.
Empty means "all supported versions".

ignore.description: Ignore suppresses findings for a rule, optionally scoped to file paths.

LintConfig.description: LintConfig controls which rule sets run and what to ignore.

kubeVersion.description:
KubeVersion pins the node image version. Empty uses the CLI's default.
Overridden by `--kube-version`.

binary.description:
Binary is the path to the backend's CLI. Empty resolves it from PATH,
then the vigie cache, then an optional download. Overridden by
`--kind-binary` / `--k3d-binary`.

extraArgs.description:
ExtraArgs are additional flags passed verbatim to the provisioning CLI.
Example: ["--config", "kind-3node.yaml"] for kind, or
["-v", "/host:/node"] for k3d.

NodeBackendConfig.description: NodeBackendConfig configures a node-backed backend (kind or k3d), each of which provisions a throwaway cluster by driving its external CLI.

name.description:
Name is the release name. Mirrors Helm's `--release-name`.
Defaults to "release-name".

namespace.description:
Namespace is the release namespace. Mirrors Helm's `--namespace`.
Defaults to "default".

ReleaseDefaults.description: ReleaseDefaults is the Helm release identity used to render every test.

applyTiers.description:
ApplyTiers selects which cluster backends `vigie run` exercises via the
apply tier. Empty/omitted means "no apply tiers — just lint+validate+test".
Valid values: any cluster backend type (envtest, simulated, kind, k3d,
kubeconfig).

RunConfig.description: RunConfig controls `vigie run` — the orchestrated command that chains lint → validate → test.

skipSchema.description: SkipSchema disables the per-test kubeconform pass when true.

kubeVersions.description:
KubeVersions used by the per-test kubeconform pass. Has no effect when
SkipSchema is true.

testsDir.description:
TestsDir overrides the discovery root for `vigie test`, in every tier.
Relative paths resolve against the chart directory. Empty falls back to
`<chart>/tests`. The directory is scanned recursively for `*_test.yaml`.

cluster.description: Cluster holds the per-backend settings for the cluster tiers.

TestConfig.description: TestConfig controls `vigie test` — both the template tier (render + assert in-process) and the cluster tiers reached with `--cluster <backend>`.

valuesFiles.description:
ValuesFiles lists value overlays to validate, layered on the chart's
`values.yaml` (helm `-f overlay.yaml` semantics). Each entry produces one
independent render+kubeconform pass. Empty means "just the baseline
render against values.yaml".

kubeVersions.description:
KubeVersions lists Kubernetes versions to validate against. Each
(overlay × kubeVersion) pair runs as a separate scenario.

set.description:
Set holds --set style key=value overrides (helm strvals semantics). Applied
as the base layer; values files take higher priority.

setLiteral.description: SetLiteral holds --set-literal style key=literalString overrides (no type coercion).

ValidateConfig.description: ValidateConfig controls `vigie validate` (chart-level: render chart with values.yaml + each overlay, then run kubeconform against the rendered docs).

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind whose findings are suppressed, e.g. `Ingress`.

name.description: Name is the object name whose findings are suppressed. Empty matches any.

messageRegex.description:
MessageRegex further narrows the suppression to violation messages
matching this regular expression. Empty matches any.

ValidateIgnoreRule.description: ValidateIgnoreRule suppresses a kubeconform finding by kind, name, and optional regex over the violation message.

title: Vigie configuration file (.vigie.yaml)
description: Config is the root of `.vigie.yaml`, the per-chart configuration file.
